- scripts/orphan_fixup_close.py:256-268 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `timeline_check` ignores cross-references whose GraphQL source is unresolved (placeholder with null number/state and `lookup_failed: false`), returns `ok: true` and lets the sweep close a fix-up that may still have an open or unreadable linked PR.
  WHY: This contradicts the documented guard of no open or unreadable linked pull request. Severity MAJOR is reported as high. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash examined this in its verification notes and concluded a deleted source cannot be an open PR, so it did not report it.
- scripts/orphan_fixup_close.py:261-262 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The heuristic `not is_pull and "html_url" not in source and state in ("open","closed")` is said to classify ordinary Issues as pull requests, so fix-ups linked to them are skipped.
  WHY: Severity was not stated by the reviewer; medium is not assigned here and the severity field is inferred only as the reviewer's correctness finding. Disputed by anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, who found that GraphQL issue sources always carry `state: null`.
- scripts/orphan_fixup_close.py:263-267 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The GraphQL-PR detection heuristic relies on an invariant (issue sources always have `state: null`) documented only in a comment, so a future helper change could silently reclassify issues as PRs.
  WHY: Forward-looking concern only. No production path misclassifies today. The reviewer rated it NIT.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:716 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The shared staging warning says "the unblock scan is skipped" even when only `scripts/orphan_fixup_close.py` is missing, in which case only the sweep is skipped.
  WHY: The log is misleading and sends the operator to the wrong component. No wrong close or dispatch occurs. Rated NIT by reviewers; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash and minimax_minimax-m3 listed it as a hardening suggestion.
